DEFAULT_AUDIO_TIP: All audio tracks are muxed, but the selected audio language will be set as default.
DEFAULT_SUBTITLE_TIP: All subtitle tracks are muxed, but the selected subtitle language will be set as default.
AUDIO_CODEC_TIP: Flac is lossless, the best default option for archival purposes. Opus at 256 kbps VBR is 3–5× smaller and perceptually transparent, but lossy.
SKIP_EXISTING_TIP: Skips any file whose .mkv is already in the output folder. Useful for resuming an interrupted batch.
FLAT_OUTPUT_TIP: Writes each .mkv straight into the output folder instead of giving every cutscene its own subfolder.
KEEP_INTERMEDIATES_TIP: Keeps the decrypted .ivf, .hca, and .ass files after muxing instead of deleting them.
APPLY_VAPOUR_SYNTH_TIP: Enable VapourSynth filtering to fix video artifacts (mostly banding) due to Hoyo's poor encoding. Very slow and heavy on CPU, can take up to an hour, varied by video length.
HARD_SUB_TIP: Burns the default subtitle into the video (no soft subs will be muxed). Good for playing somewhere that doesn't support soft subs. Re-encodes with the x265 settings.
CRF_TIP: x265 quality, 0 to 51. Lower means better quality and bigger file.
PRESET_TIP: x265 speed against efficiency. Slower presets take longer for a smaller file at the same quality.
X265_PARAMS_TIP: Built-in tuning for the preset. 'ultrafast' to 'medium' uses the same neutral tuning parameters that improve picture quality without affecting encode speed. 'slow' to 'placebo' uses the same but with added parameters for better quality.
RESET_TO_DEFAULTS_TIP: Reset all settings to default. Click on OK to confirm.

CAPTURE_INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Press Start and accept the administrator prompt.
2. Start Genshin Impact and go through the door on the login screen.
3. When the keys appear below, press Stop, then Copy all.
CAPTURE_NEW_ONLY_TIP: Hides keys that are already in keys.json.
CAPTURE_ENGINE_STOPPED: The engine exited before the capture started.
